name: kawhithennow
caption:
KAWHI VS KAWHI 🎮🏀 Kawhi won us a title at 27. Now he's back with us at 35.

• 2018-19, age 27: 26.6 PPG, 7.3 RPG, then 30.5 PPG in the playoffs and Finals MVP
• 2025-26 with the Clippers, age 34: 27.9 PPG, a career high
• Sept 14, 2026: we trade for him again
• First 2 games back: 19.5 PPG, 7.5 RPG, 3.5 SPG, then a swollen left knee

2019 Kawhi or this Kawhi? 👇

beats.head: KAWHI VS KAWHI
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Kawhi Leonard won us a title at twenty-seven. Now he's back with us at thirty-five. Which Kawhi is better?

beats.head: 2019 KAWHI
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Twenty nineteen Kawhi: twenty-six point six a night, then thirty point five in the playoffs, and Finals MVP.

beats.head: STILL GOT IT
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: But last season, at thirty-four, he scored twenty-seven point nine a night for the Clippers. A career high.
beats.dlg: LAST SEASON, AGE 34:|27.9 PPG. CAREER HIGH.

beats.head: BACK WITH US
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Back with us, through two games: nineteen point five points, seven point five rebounds, three and a half steals. Then a swollen knee.

beats.head: WHO'S BETTER?
beats.vo: Twenty nineteen Kawhi, or this Kawhi? Comment below.

facts.claim: Leonard (born June 29, 1991) was 27 in 2018-19 when he won the 2019 title and Finals MVP with Toronto, 34 in 2025-26 (his career high in scoring with the Clippers), and is 35 now; on September 14, 2026 (Sept 14) he was traded back to Toronto; on October 27, 2026 he was ruled out at least a week with swelling in his left knee; he wears No. 2 (#2) for Toronto
